description: Check that the generated files match .flisk/project.json and that every service.json is valid. By default returns a small summary: every error line and data.diffs entries with file, state (missing or different), linesAdded and linesRemoved, without file bodies. Pass diffFiles (paths from data.diffs, e.g. .flisk/.flisk-out/Tiltfile or Tiltfile) to request diffs for those files only, capped at 200 lines each with a truncation note; the CLI equivalent is flisk config verify --diff <file>. A drifted generated file is fixed with config_regenerate. Set projectPath when the MCP server is not running from the project root. CLI equivalent: `flisk config verify --json`.

diffFiles.description: Include a capped diff for each named drifted file instead of a summary only

items.description: A path reported in data.diffs, e.g. .flisk/.flisk-out/Tiltfile

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the Flisk project root; run this operation from that directory.

name: config_verify
